name: what's your name?
source:
"what's your name?" is a semi-fictional visual novel about name change process - the paperwork you have to file, the people you have to talk to, the time you have to wait.

[Edited from [url=https://sxilin.itch.io/namegame]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你叫什么名字？”是一部关于更名过程的半虚构视觉小说——你必须提交的文件、你必须与之交谈的人、你必须等待的时间。

[编辑自[url=https://sxilin.itch.io/namegame]Itch.io[/url]]
